# floating point

> floating point (Floating Point Solutions, Lda.) is a software and cybersecurity company in Aveiro, Portugal. It designs, builds and runs software for companies of any size, from a first product to the systems a whole operation depends on, and it finds security weaknesses before someone else does, fixes them, and keeps watch afterwards. Tagline: "built to the last digit."

The site is available in English (https://www.flt.pt/) and European Portuguese (https://www.flt.pt/pt/). New work starts with a short brief sent to info@flt.pt; the team replies within two working days.

## Services

### Software
- Web and mobile applications
- Internal platforms and back-office tools
- Integrations and APIs
- Data pipelines and reporting
- Cloud infrastructure and DevOps
- Maintenance and modernisation of existing systems

### Cybersecurity
- Security assessments and risk management
- Hardening and compliance (ISO 27001, NIS2, GDPR)
- Monitoring and threat detection
- Incident response
- Secure development and code review
- Security training for teams

## How a project runs
1. Brief: the client sends a paragraph describing what they are building, what is hard about it and when they need it. floating point replies within two working days with questions.
2. Scope: floating point writes down what gets built, the price and the date. The client signs it.
3. Build: delivery in regular increments until it is in production, with support for fixes afterwards.
